request.query: The weighted order of a polynomial as a multivariate power series equals the minimum weight of its support

items.name: MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder
items.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [Semiring R] → (σ → ℕ) → MvPowerSeries σ R → ℕ∞

items.name: MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder_eq_nat
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} {n : ℕ},
  MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f = ↑n ↔
    (∃ d, (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f ≠ 0 ∧ (Finsupp.weight w) d = n) ∧
      ∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), (Finsupp.weight w) d < n → (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f = 0

items.name: MvPowerSeries.order
items.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [Semiring R] → MvPowerSeries σ R → ℕ∞

items.name: MvPowerSeries.le_weightedOrder
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} {n : ℕ∞},
  (∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), ↑((Finsupp.weight w) d) < n → (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f = 0) → n ≤ MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f

items.name: MvPowerSeries.le_order_smul
items.type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} {a : R}, f.order ≤ (a • f).order

items.name: MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder_monomial
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {d : σ →₀ ℕ} {a : R} [inst_1 : Decidable (a = 0)],
  MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w ((MvPowerSeries.monomial d) a) = if a = 0 then ⊤ else ↑((Finsupp.weight w) d)

items.name: MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder_le
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f : MvPowerSeries σ R} {d : σ →₀ ℕ},
  (MvPowerSeries.coeff d) f ≠ 0 → MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f ≤ ↑((Finsupp.weight w) d)

items.name: MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder_monomial_of_ne_zero
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {d : σ →₀ ℕ} {a : R},
  a ≠ 0 → MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w ((MvPowerSeries.monomial d) a) = ↑((Finsupp.weight w) d)
